problem: Fatou conjecture that a quadratic family of maps from the complex plane to itself is hyperbolic for an open dense set of parameters
missing_details: Specification of the quadratic family as f_c(z)=z^2+c
Explicit declaration of the parameter space c ∈ ℂ
Formal definition of hyperbolicity (all critical points lie in the basin of an attracting periodic cycle)
Clarification that “open dense set of parameters” refers to openness and density in the standard topology on ℂ
refined_question: Determine whether the set of parameters c in the complex plane ℂ for which the quadratic polynomial f_c:ℂ→ℂ defined by f_c(z)=z^2+c is hyperbolic forms an open dense subset of ℂ.
justification: The original problem name indicates the aim (density of hyperbolicity) and the map family (quadratic maps on ℂ) but omits key details needed for a self-contained statement: the explicit form of the family (f_c(z)=z^2+c), the topology and domain for the parameter c, the precise notion of hyperbolicity, and the meaning of open and dense. A completeness score of 5 reflects that while the central theme is present, these technical specifics are missing. The refined formulation includes all necessary definitions and scope to pose the conjecture independently.
